title: FLA import: ReferenceError motionEaseCurve crashes all symbol and scene stream parsing — entire doc blank
description:
CRITICAL. When loading Magnet.fla, every symbol stream and every scene (page) stream fails with:

  ReferenceError: motionEaseCurve is not defined
  at flash8-import.ts:795 (symbol parsing)
  at flash8-import.ts:839 (scene/page parsing)

Each failure is caught and logged as a warning, importing that stream as empty. ALL ~65 symbol streams and ALL 6 scene streams fail this way. The resulting document has:
- 87 library items in 0 scenes × 0 objects (doc_summary confirms: all keyframes show objectCount: 0)
- Test Movie renders a blank white SWF in Ruffle (no content at all)

Observed in QA run 4 console (console-run4.txt). Exact log lines:
  [FLA import] could not parse symbol stream "Symbol 1": ReferenceError: motionEaseCurve is not defined — importing as empty symbol
  [FLA import] could not parse page stream "Page 1": ReferenceError: motionEaseCurve is not defined — importing empty scene
  (× ~65 symbols + × 6 scenes)

This is different from task 0883 (which tracks the Bezier curve data not being decoded). This bug causes a JavaScript ReferenceError during parsing — motionEaseCurve is used as a variable/function inside the symbol/page parsing try-block but is not defined in scope at that point.

Expected: symbol and scene streams parse successfully; the Bezier ease data may be missing (0883) but parsing must not crash.
Result: all content is blank; Magnet.fla is completely unplayable.
